board: An ESP32 board running ESPHome 2026.10 or newer
result: See your ESPHome device's readings on your Warblet dashboard, and get an email when one passes a limit.
firstMessage: It sends its first report about a minute after it starts, then one a minute.

routine.name: ESPHome: email when a reading passes a limit

connect.label: ESPHome
connect.text:
warblet_{id}: "{code}"
packages:
  warblet:
    url: https://github.com/Robota-LLC/Warblet-IoT
    ref: v1.5.0
    files:
      - path: esphome/warblet.yaml
        vars:
          id: {id}
          code: !secret warblet_{id}
